events.description:
## The Art Of Touch

A Foundational Massage Practitioner Course\
27.10 – 30.10 2025

Would you like to learn how to give (and receive) a heart-centred, deeply relaxing massage\
Maybe you’ve been feeling a certain energy in your hands and a wish to explore the field of massage and bodywork

In this 4-day training course you will learn principles and techniques that will give you the skills and confidence to give a full body relaxation massage with oil

Throughout the course you'll explore both the physical as well as energetic aspects of massage therapy\
The main focus is the quality of touch and the connection between giver and receiver rather than anatomy knowledge

### Who is this for

For anyone who would like to explore the gifts we can bring through touch\
For beginners as well as those already practicing healing arts who want to deepen understanding

### Learning outcomes

* Foundations to give a deeply relaxing nurturing massage with confidence
* Techniques for a complete full body massage
* Effects of massage therapy on body-mind and nervous system
* Deeper connection with yourself and your body
* Keep energy flowing without getting exhausted as a giver
* Attunement and intuitive sensitivity
* Attitude of loving presence
* Connect with a small international group to continue practicing
* Receive a video of the sequence you learn

### Workshop hours

* Saturday 11:00–17:30
* Sunday 11:00–18:30
* Monday 10:00–16:30
* Tuesday 11:00–18:30

Shared vegetarian lunch each day

### 3-tier pricing

* 370€ low income
* 410€ fair
* 450€ supportive

Small group (max. 8 participants)\
Workshop held in English, translations into German and Spanish possible\
60€ referral discount, bring a friend\
One helper spot available for 275€

Registration contact as listed on the page via Telegram/WhatsApp: +351927576899

### Meet the Facilitator

Julia Ocean\
Therapeutic massage practitioner, yoga teacher and multifaceted artist\
Passionate about facilitating deep relaxation and nurturing and creating transformative healing experiences through loving presence and mindful touch

#### Here is one of my latest reviews:

> I had the wonderful opportunity to participate in Julia’s massage course, which gave me a deep and well-rounded insight into her work and teaching style. From the very beginning, the atmosphere felt incredibly warm, familiar and truly on eye-level — something I deeply value, especially as a learner.
>
> The course offered a beautiful balance between theory and practice. Julia was always open to questions and made sure everyone felt seen and supported. I learned so much — especially the massage basics, the do’s and don’ts — making this course perfect for anyone starting out.
>
> The setting was absolutely stunning and sharing our lunch breaks with potluck meals brought the group even closer together. It felt more like a shared journey than just a course. Julia is not only an amazing teacher, but also a beautiful soul. Truly a special experience that I can wholeheartedly recommend.
>
> Miriam

events.description:
## The Embodied Woman
An AUTHENTIC SHAPES RETREAT  
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
OCTOBER 7th – 11th 2025

Embodied wisdom begins when a woman listens to her body

Five days to reconnect with your body, return to your inner truth and embody your natural feminine strength

You crave deeper intimacy and a more embodied connection with yourself and with others  
But the daily hustle pulls you out of your flow  
When we give ourselves space to feel, we notice what’s truly going on inside  
Emotions may surface  
Forgotten parts of ourselves may begin to speak  
And in that quiet awareness, something powerful is revealed

Your body holds wisdom  
When we learn to truly listen, our body guides us  
It tells us when to rest, when to move, when to say yes and when to say no  
This is what it means to live in alignment — to trust the voice within instead of seeking validation from the outside  
You don’t need to become more or do more  
Your strength is already within you — ready to be felt, expressed and shared

### The Facilitator
Cindy de Vogel  
Mentor, trauma-informed breathwork facilitator, 1:1 coach, sacred space holder, somatic yoga teacher

## Harvest of the Heart
A 5RHYTHMS HEARTBEAT RETREAT  
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
SEPTEMBER 6–11, 2025

Step away from the noise and into the rhythm of integration

A 6-day, 5-night 5Rhythms retreat in the raw beauty of nature — where land, sea and sky invite you to dance through the change of the season, release what’s ready to go and harvest what’s truly yours

This retreat offers a chance to step away from daily routines and into a rhythm that reflects the shifting season  
Through 5Rhythms Waves & Heartbeat, move with cycles of fullness, release and deep integration — allowing the body to unwind, the heart to open and the mind to soften  
Movement as a way to reclaim presence, emotional clarity and embodied freedom

Set in Essência’s secluded retreat center between rolling hills and the vast ocean  
Enjoy sauna session, refreshing dips in the wild lake, nourishing vegan meals and time to breathe in the raw beauty of the land  
Between sessions: walk the coastline, rest under the open sky and let nature guide you back to center

### The Facilitators
Vehllia Tranne & Alessandro Moruzzi  
Certified 5Rhythms® Teachers and founders of The City Waves 5Rhythms® (San Francisco)

events.description:
Picture yourself waking up with the first rays of autumn sun filtering through linen curtains and warming your skin.

The room is quiet. Outside, you hear birds singing, the kind of sound that settles your whole system before you even open your eyes.

You walk barefoot to the terrace with a warm cup of coffee or herbal tea, observing the trees and the birds in the forest that surrounds you. The morning is slow. There’s no one asking for you. No notifications. Nowhere else to be.

You begin your day with conscious movement that feels good in your body, not another task on your to-do list, but something you actually want to do.

You’ll laugh with women you met just days ago, yet somehow feel like you’ve known for years.

You’ll enjoy the warmth of Portugal’s south coast. You’ll surf, rest, journal, move and stargaze under clear October skies.

You’ll remember what it feels like to live from presence — instead of rush or pressure.

This is Flow State Retreat.

An experience designed to help your nervous system recalibrate.
Where movement, rest, play and connection bring you back into regulation.

Where your body feels safe enough to slow down and strong enough to expand.

[More information & booking](https://www.catarinaamaralyoga.com/flowstateretreat)

events.description:
Join us for a ten-day immersion in Portugal that unites **Spagyric laboratory work, astrology, and phytotherapy**, offering a direct experience of how **Hermetic principles** come alive through the healing intelligence of nature — transforming plants into medicine for **body, spirit, and soul**.

Through **philosophy, hands-on practice, storytelling, astrology, and Spagyric phytotherapy**, you will learn to capture the essence of plants and craft remedies that nurture both the physical body and the subtle dimensions of being.

Step by step, you will be guided through the foundations of Spagyric practice: **distilling essential oils and aromatic waters, preparing medicinal wines, purifying salts, and reuniting body, spirit, and soul to make a Spagyric tincture.**

The study of **planetary archetypes and astrological correspondences** will deepen your understanding of timing, energetics, and balance — the scientific and philosophical foundation of the Hermetic principle *“As above, so below.”*

### **What You Will Experience and Lear**n

#### **Part I – Capturing the Soul**

* Essential oil distillation (complete extraction)
* Aromatic waters
* Oleolites (oil infusions)
* Melites (honey infusions)

#### **Parts II & III – Spirit & Body**

* Fermentation of the Spirit & medicinal wines
* Crafting Spagyric tinctures and exploring their unique properties
* Calcination & purification of salts
* Reunification of body, spirit & soul
* Introduction to Spagyric Quintessences and their physical and energetic effects

[More Information](https://www.kermesspagyric.com/event/spagyric-immersion-portugal/)

**Voice Your Freedom Workshop**

*3pm - 5pm*

The workshop is an opportunity to meet your truest inner essence in a profound, intimate and safe way. A deep journey of embodiment, breath, alignment as well as full surrender, direct connection to spirit. We move, we breathe, we sing and we rest and receive. Remembering who we truly are. Simple, direct, effortless, joyous.

Lulu & Mischka have both worked with their voices for various decades as a tool for transformation, expression, somatic harmony, art, music and true liberation. They have worked with vocal masters from vast backgrounds such as Indian classical, western classical and opera, as well as other intuitive vocal masters. Their approach is light-hearted, yet profound; the workshop is for all who have a voice. It is for those who feel shy around their voices, as well as those who have already cultivated a lot of connection and wish to go deeper.

*\- dinner break -*

**Sonic Medicine Chanting Concert**

*7pm - 9.15pm*

A ceremonial concert that invites all listeners to sing their hearts. Chants, mantras and prayers from around the world inspire the space to become a collective field of resonance. Gorgeous melodies blend with heart-felt lyrics and ancient languages that invoke a deep sense of unity and remembrance. Lulu & Mischka’s vocals enchant listeners around the world, their chemistry with each other and the audience brings a sense of peace and joy that is uniquely heart-opening.

- - -

**Kids**\
Children who want to be there are welcome.
Toddlers who need to run around and play, please do so at home (this space is not a playground)
Babies in arms are welcome as long as they flow with the energy well

- - -

Come as you are. No experience needed. Just your body, your breath and your willingness to move.

### A Ceremony for the Healing of the Womb

We warmly invite you to a sacred ceremony dedicated to the healing and harmonization of feminine energy: the 13th Rite of the Munay-Ki.

This beautiful initiation, rooted in the wisdom of the Amazonian tradition, is passed from woman to woman, honoring the lineage of feminine strength and remembrance.

The womb is more than a physical space — it is a center of intuition, creativity, connection, and life force. Within it lives the ancient wisdom of the feminine. When we reconnect with this sacred space within our bodies, we reconnect with our primal source, our inner strength, and our authentic power as women.

Through this rite, we create a safe and supportive space where healing, release, and remembrance can unfold. Together, we honor our bodies, our stories, and the creative energy that flows through us.

This ceremony can be deeply moving and transformative — a gentle yet powerful invitation to come home to yourself.

events.description:
### Shedding the Old Skin & Awakening Anew 🐍

In the ancient Andean tradition, Amaru — the Great Medicine Serpent — is a powerful guardian of transformation. Just as the serpent sheds her skin, Amaru teaches us how to release what no longer serves us and step into renewed clarity, vitality, and inner strength.

I warmly invite you to a transformative one-day workshop where we will connect deeply with the spirit of Amaru and enter her field of powerful renewal.

### What Awaits You

#### 🐍 Shamanic Journey to the Lower World
Through a guided shamanic journey, you will meet Amaru and connect with her medicine. Her energy supports you in releasing old layers held within your energetic body.

#### 🌘 Meditation: Identifying Your “Old Skin”
A reflective inner process to recognize the patterns, stories, or emotional imprints you are ready to shed.

#### 🔥 Amaru Ceremony – Energetic Transformation
In this sacred ritual, Amaru is invoked to work within the space. Participants are supported in shedding old energetic layers, creating space for new awareness and alignment.

#### 🔥 Andean Fire Ritual
A powerful offering ceremony where you symbolically and energetically surrender the old to the fire, deepening your process of transformation.

#### 🌬️ Energetic Cleansing Rituals
Purification practices to clear your energy field and prepare your body and spirit for renewal.

#### 🌏 Closing Ceremony for Pachamama
A heartfelt ritual honoring Mother Earth, grounding your experience and blessing your new beginning.

This workshop offers an immersive and profound journey of renewal — guided by the transformative spirit of Amaru.

If you feel the call of the Serpent, this is an invitation to shed the old and awaken anew. 🐍✨

Tief erdig, haptisch, mystisch, dunkel durch die Arbeit mit Mutter Erde, dem Raum der Gebärmutter und deiner weiblichen Spiritualität.



Gleichzeitig innerlich frei, weit & leicht, geführt, lichtvoll und von Klarheit durchströmt, durch die Verbundenheit mit Schöpfung und Co-Creation mit der Quelle allen Seins.

•	Rituale & Innenweltreisen: um deine Gebärmutter nicht nur als Organ, sondern als Intelligenz in dir zu fühlen

•	The Guru in You: du wirst an deine eigene Weisheit und Anbindung erinnert und nicht vom Außen „gefüttert“ 

•	Frauengesundheit: Anwendungen für deine eigene Pflege oder zur Anwendung bei anderen Frauen

•	Persönlichkeitsentwicklung: mit Anteilen deiner Selbst in Kontakt treten und dich GANZ wahrnehmen

•	Kleine Gruppe (max. 14 Teilnehmerinnen)
